title: Meta is training its AI on millions of Australians, but now you can stop it
paragraphs: Meta has quietly introduced a way for Australians to stop it from training its AI on their user data, but the company never announced the change.
An "objection" form has been available for more than a year, but digital rights advocates believe Meta does not want people to find it.
Advice on how to opt out is slowly spreading as Meta users share information among themselves.
